title: AI Creative Operations Manager
description:
Job Post: AI Creative Operations Manager

Position: AI Creative Operations Manager / Technical Team Lead

Location: Remote — Philippines

Employment Type: Full-Time after a successful paid pilot

Paid Pilot: 2 weeks — $400 USD flat project fee

Full-Time Compensation: $1,500–$1,800 USD per month to start, depending on experience, with room for growth



Company: Rudderr LLC



This position is designed as a senior systems-builder and quality-control leader, not a general virtual assistant or entry-level graphic designer. The manager will build and operate a scalable AI-assisted content team, recruit and train junior editors, create repeatable workflows, and enforce strict product-accuracy standards. 

 

About Rudderr



Rudderr is an e-commerce brand management and wholesale growth company that helps consumer brands expand across Amazon, Walmart, Shopify, Faire, and social media.

We manage products across several categories, including outdoor and survival gear, home improvement, lawn and garden, wellness, beauty, and specialty consumer products.

We are building an internal AI-assisted content production operation capable of producing high-quality product lifestyle images, short-form videos, and UGC-style content at scale.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced AI Creative Operations Manager to build, lead, and manage our Philippines-based content production team.

You will not be expected to create every image or video yourself. Your primary responsibility will be to build the people, systems, workflows, and quality-control process required to deliver accurate, realistic, and premium e-commerce content consistently.

You will receive original product photography and creative direction from our U.S. team. You will then manage a team of junior AI image and video editors who transform those product photos into realistic lifestyle scenes, advertising assets, social media content, and short-form videos.

Our most important standard is product fidelity. Logos, dimensions, materials, colors, proportions, accessories, controls, textures, and product features must remain accurate. Product distortion, invented features, incorrect branding, and visibly artificial imagery must be caught and corrected before delivery.



Primary Responsibilities

Build and Manage the Creative Team

• Recruit and evaluate junior AI image editors, video editors, and creative production contractors. 

• Handle onboarding, training, performance reviews, coaching, and replacement of underperforming tea
mbers. 

• Maintain sufficient staffing so content production does not stop when an editor becomes unavailable. 

• Assign work based on each editor’s skills, availability, and performance. 

• Build a reliable team capable of increasing or decreasing production based on demand. 

Build the Content Production System

• Create repeatable workflows for AI-assisted product photography, lifestyle imagery, video, and synthetic UGC. 

• Develop SOPs, templates, prompt libraries, brand guidelines, file-naming systems, and quality-control checklists. 

• Establish a clear process from receiving original product photos through final asset approval. 

• Organize project files, source images, masks, models, prompts, revisions, and final exports. 

• Improve production speed without sacrificing product accuracy or visual quality. 

• Work toward a typical delivery time of approximately 24–48 hours for standard content requests. 

Own Quality Control

• Review every asset before it reaches the U.S. team. 

• Enforce a zero-tolerance standard for distorted products, altered logos, incorrect colors, missing accessories, unrealistic shadows, and inconsistent proportions. 

• Check perspective, lighting direction, contact shadows, reflections, scale, resolution, texture, anatomy, and environmental realism. 

• Identify whether an asset can be corrected through inpainting, masking, compositing, relighting, regeneration, or manual Photoshop editing. 

• Train junior editors to recognize common AI generation errors. 

• Maintain consistency across image collections, recurring virtual models, brand campaigns, and product variations. 



Manage AI Image and Video Production

• Oversee the creation of realistic lifestyle scenes using original product photography. 

• Ensure that the actual product remains accurate while environments, backgrounds, people, and scenarios are generated or composited around it. 

• Direct the creation of outdoor, camping, water-sports, home, wellness, and other product-specific lifestyle scenarios. 

• Manage short-form video production using still product images, generated environments, motion effects, and AI video tools. 

• Develop recurring virtual creators or product experts for TikTok, Instagram Reels, advertising, and educational content. 

• Ensure temporal consistency so products remain sharp and stable while backgrounds or surrounding elements move naturally. 

Manage Performance and Communication

• Serve as the primary point of contact between Rudderr and the creative production team. 

• Translate creative requests into clear assignments for junior editors. 

• Track production volume, revision rates, approval rates, turnaround time, and editor performance. 

• Provide regular updates on project status, staffing, bottlenecks, and tool requirements. 

• Recommend workflow, staffing, and software improvements based on measurable results. 

• Manage software access and ensure company assets, trained models, and workflows remain organized and secure. 

The operational model including manager ownership of recruiting, onboarding, training, performance management, production continuity, and final quality is central to this position. 



Required Experience

• At least 3 years of experience managing a creative, multimedia, design, post-production, or digital content team. 

• Demonstrated experience recruiting, training, and managing remote creative professionals. 

• Strong understanding of e-commerce product photography and lifestyle content. 

• Advanced ability to review and correct AI-generated images. 

• Strong attention to product accuracy, branding, visual realism, and fine details. 

• Experience building SOPs, creative workflows, quality-control systems, and performance standards. 

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, including: 

o Layer-based compositing 

o Precise masking 

o Generative Fill 

o Color correction 

o Shadow and reflection creation 

o Perspective correction 

o Image cleanup and retouching 

• Strong written and spoken English. 

• Reliable high-speed internet and a computer capable of managing professional image and video workflows. 

• Ability to work independently, make decisions, and communicate problems before they affect deadlines. 



Preferred Technical Experience

Strong candidates should have hands-on experience with several of the following:

• ComfyUI or another node-based Stable Diffusion workflow 

• ControlNet, including Depth, Canny, and related control methods 

• IP-Adapter or product-reference conditioning 

• Advanced inpainting and outpainting 

• Product masking and image compositing 

• IC-Light or similar AI relighting tools 

• BiRefNet, InspyreNet, or advanced background-removal workflows 

• Photoroom Pro 

• Flair.ai 

• Adobe Photoshop and After Effects 

• Runway 

• Kling AI 

• Luma Dream Machine 

• PixVerse 

• HeyGen 

• Captions.ai 

• AI avatar or synthetic UGC workflows 

• Project-management tools such as Asana, ClickUp, Trello, or 
 

We are specifically looking for candidates who understand controlled, repeatable AI production and not someone whose experience is limited to entering prompts into ChatGPT or Midjourney. The technical requirements reflect the need for node-based workflows, controlled product placement, advanced masking, relighting, motion consistency, and professional Photoshop correction. 



Helpful Additional Experience

• Outdoor, survival, camping, water-sports, home-improvement, or consumer-product brands 

• Managing freelance or offshore production teams 

• Creating content for multiple brands at the same time 

• Developing recurring virtual models or AI-generated brand ambassadors 

• Capacity planning and creative production budgeting 

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 30–60 days, the successful candidate will have:

• Recruited and evaluated a dependable group of junior editors. 

• Established clear production and quality-control SOPs. 

• Created a dependable workflow for receiving, producing, reviewing, revising, and delivering assets. 

• Reduced preventable revisions caused by product distortion or overlooked AI defects. 

• Built a consistent pipeline for realistic product lifestyle imagery. 

• Established measurable expectations for turnaround time, asset quality, and editor performance. 

• Begun expanding the operation into video and UGC-style content. 

Two-Week Paid Pilot

Finalists will begin with a paid two-week project.

During the pilot, the candidate will be asked to:

• Source and evaluate two to three potential junior editors. 

• Provide clear creative assignments using several test product photographs. 

• Direct the editors in creating distinct lifestyle-image concepts. 

• Develop a short-form video concept for each test product. 

• Review AI-generated images and identify product, lighting, anatomy, perspective, and realism problems. 

• Demonstrate how they would organize the workflow, manage revisions, and approve final assets. 

• Present a proposed team structure, production process, and quality-control checklist. 

The purpose of the pilot is not to determine whether the manager can personally create every asset. It is intended to evaluate the candidate’s ability to find talent, communicate standards, build systems, manage production, and prevent defective work from reaching the client.

Junior editor expenses approved for the pilot or ongoing operation will be managed under a separate company-funded production budget and will not be deducted from the manager’s compensation.



How to Apply

Please submit the following:

1. Your resume and LinkedIn profile to 
 A brief description of the largest creative or production team you have managed. 

3. Examples of e-commerce images, videos, AI workflows, or creative projects you personally managed or quality-checked. 

4. A list of the AI image, video, editing, and project-management tools you have used professionally. 

5. A short explanation of how you would place a real product into an AI-generated environment without changing its logo, shape, proportions, or important features. 

6. An example of a time you recruited or replaced a tea
mber under a tight deadline. 

7. Your current employment or client commitments. 

8. Your earliest available start date. 

9. Your expected full-time monthly compensation. 



Please begin your application with the words “PRODUCT FIDELITY” so we know you carefully reviewed the position.

Generic applications that do not address the management, technical, and quality-control requirements will not be considered.

We are a small Australian outdoor travel company seeking a Logistics Manager to support and ensure the smooth running of our operations.

 

This is a long-term, full-time position for someone who is able to work exclusively with us. The role requires strong English communication skills, independent thinking, and consistent day-to-day communication.

 

The nature of this role is highly varied and will suit someone who enjoys learning different skills and systems.

 

Key Responsibilities:

* Coordinate and manage trip logistics

* Communicate with clients via
 and SMS

* Oversee company permits and compliance reporting

* Purchase company supplies

* Support product research and development

* Assist with admin ad hoc tasks

 

Requirements:

* C2 level English proficiency

* Reliable internet connection

* Ability to commit full-time exclusively to our company

 

What We Offer:

* Starting salary of $1150 AUD per month, with annual reviews and potential bonuses

* Working hours: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Philippine Time)

* 13th month pay

* Paid sick leave

* 25 flexible paid days off per year (including holidays)

* Health insurance (AllCare)

* Fortnightly pay cycle

* No requirement to use TimeProof

 

How to Apply:

Please submit your CV and a short video introduction (1–2 minutes) addressing the following:

1. Start the video by saying 'Hello Maddie' - so we know it's not a generic video :)

2. Brief introduction about yourself and your work experience

3. The tools and systems you have used (e.g. CRM, booking systems, etc.)

 

Please use the subject line:?“Logistics Manager + [Your Name] + [Your Favourite Fruit]”

 

We look forward to working with you!

title: Growth Assistant — Lead Generation & Outreach (AI Marketing)
description:
About VORA

VORA is a small AI marketing agency that helps local service businesses grow using done-for-you

digital marketing tools. We identify missed growth opportunities, bring in new customers, and

automate marketing — without the business needing a full team.



About This Role

We are looking for a motivated, organized Growth Assistant to help us reach out to small business

owners and start conversations that lead to a free AI marketing consultation.

This is a part-time remote role with real earning potential through client bonuses. If you are consistent,

detail-oriented, and enjoy connecting with people online — this role is for you.



What You Will Do

- Research and build daily lists of local service businesses (salons, med spas, chiropractors,

dentists, fitness studios, wellness clinics, contractors, home services)

- Send outreach messages via Instagram DM,
, and
 using provided scripts

- Personalize each message — no copy-paste spam

- Start genuine conversations and invite business owners to receive a free 12-month AI Growth

Plan

- Track all outreach in a shared Google Sheet (business name, contact, platform, date, response,

follow-up)

- Follow up with leads on a set schedule: Day 3, Day 7, Day 14

- Hand off interested leads to our closer — no selling or closing required on your end

- Send a brief daily check-in update and a weekly summary



What We Are Looking For

- Strong written English — friendly, natural, professional

- Organized and consistent — you hit your daily targets without being reminded

- Comfortable using
, Instagram, Gmail, and Google Sheets

- Self-starter who does not need micromanagement

- Experience with lead generation, outreach, or appointment setting is a plus — but we will train the

right person



Bonus Tools (Nice to Have)

Apollo, Hunter.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, GoHighLevel, Instantly, HubSpot



Pay & Bonuses

- Starting rate: $4/hour

- 2-week paid trial at 10 hours/week

- Rate review and potential raise after successful trial

- $50 bonus for every client who signs as a paying client (paid after first payment clears)



How to Apply

Send a short message (3 to 5 sentences) telling us:

1. Why you are interested in this role

2. Any experience you have with outreach, social media, or lead generation

3. What tools or platforms you are most comfortable using



$4.00 USD per hour — starting rate, with review and raise after successful 2-week trial.

Bonus: $50 USD per signed paying client (paid after first payment clears).



Flexible — you set your own hours within your agreed weekly total. Must be available to respond to

messages within 4 hours during your workday.

title: Social Media Ads Manager + TikTok Shop & UGC Specialist (US Market)
description:
About Us:



Skip the Groomer is a fast-growing US pet grooming brand selling on TikTok Shop and our own Shopify store. We have new products launching in 3 months and need experienced support in place now to build and execute a strategy that's ready on day one.

What You'll Own:



Meta Ads 
 + Instagram) — campaign setup, creative testing, optimization, reporting

TikTok Shop — product listings, affiliate/creator outreach, shop management, promotions (US market only)

Google Ads — search and/or shopping campaigns

UGC — sourcing creators, briefing content, coordinating delivery, tracking performance



You're a great fit if you:



Have hands-on experience in at least one of the above — you do NOT need to be an expert in all four. We'd rather hire someone exceptional at one or two things than someone mediocre across all of them

Have managed a TikTok Shop in the US market specifically — international experience does not qualify for this role

Have run paid ads in Meta Ads Manager or TikTok Ads Manager (not just boosting posts)

Know how to source, brief, and manage UGC creators

Have worked with pet, dog, or animal care brands — this is a strong plus and will move your application to the top

Can work independently, communicate results clearly, and move quickly



?? Applications that do not address all of the "great fit" criteria above will not be reviewed. Please be specific about which areas apply to you and which don't.

A note on expertise:



You don't need to be a master of everything — but if you consider yourself an expert in one specific area (Meta Ads, TikTok Shop, Google Ads, or UGC), tell us exactly why. What results have you driven? What brands? What did you learn that most people in that role don't know?

Open to Teams:



If you have 1–2 other people you've worked closely with in the past who cover different skills, we're open to hearing about a small team of up to 3. Tell us who they are, what they do, and how you've worked together.

Compensation:



We don't post a fixed rate — please propose your own pay based on the skills and experience you bring. Be specific: if you're applying as a team, break it down by person and role.

Availability:



We need someone available to start immediately. New products launch in 3 months — there is no ramp-up runway.

To apply, include:



Which of the four areas (Meta, TikTok Shop, Google, UGC) you've worked on and for how long

If you consider yourself an expert in any area, explain exactly why

One example of a campaign, shop, or UGC project you managed — include results

Any experience with pet, dog, or animal care brands

Your availability (part-time or full-time)

Your proposed monthly rate — or a team breakdown if applying with others

* Follow up with candidates regarding onboarding requirements.

* Update internal tracking systems and reports.

* Monitor deadlines and outstanding tasks.

* Assist leadership with operational projects as needed.

* Support departmental coverage during staff absences.



Qualifications

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Excellent written and verbal English communication.

* High attention to detail and accuracy.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, Excel

*Follow-up and accountability

title: Assistant Property Manager / Maintenance Coordinator

Assistant Property Manager / Maintenance Coordinator

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pacific Time with a 1-hour unpaid break



Salary: $1,000 per month

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Assistant Property Manager / Maintenance Coordinator to support the day-to-day operations of our property management team, with a primary focus on coordinating and overseeing maintenance requests from initiation through completion. This individual will serve as a key liaison between tenants, vendors, and the internal property management team to ensure a high level of service and operational efficiency.

Manage and track maintenance requests through AppFolio and Maintenance Performer from initiation to completion.

Leverage Maintenance Performer's AI-powered workflows and tools to improve maintenance coordination, communication, and work order resolution times.

Review incoming maintenance requests and assess urgency to ensure time-sensitive issues are prioritized appropriately.

Coordinate with tenants, vendors, and internal tea
mbers to schedule and facilitate maintenance work.

Assist with additional property management and administrative tasks as needed.

Previous property management, assistant property management, or property administration experience preferred.

Experience with AppFolio is highly preferred, with the ability to navigate and manage property management workflows efficiently.

Experience with Maintenance Performer or other AI-powered property management and maintenance platforms is a plus.

Experience coordinating maintenance requests, work orders, vendors, and tenant communications.

Strong understanding of maintenance workflows and the ability to assess and prioritize requests based on urgency.

Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines, and follow-ups simultaneously.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Detail-oriented with excellent problem-solving skills and follow-through.

Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with a distributed team.

Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and property management systems.

Ability to maintain professionalism when communicating with tenants, vendors, and internal tea
mbers.

Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Tax Preparation Support
description:
Position Summary



We are seeking an experienced Remote Tax Accountant / Tax Preparer to prepare and review individual and business tax returns, support tax planning initiatives, and ensure compliance with applicable tax regulations. The ideal candidate has experience with U.S. tax preparation, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment.



Key Responsibilities

Prepare and review U.S. federal and state tax returns for individuals, partnerships, LLCs, corporations, and S corporations.

Gather, organize, and analyze client financial and tax documents.

Prepare tax workpapers and supporting schedules.

Identify deductions, credits, and tax-saving opportunities for clients.

Perform tax research and assist with complex tax issues.

Communicate with clients to obtain missing information and answer tax-related questions.

Assist with tax planning strategies throughout the year.

Prepare quarterly estimated tax calculations.

Respond to IRS and state tax notices when needed.

Maintain accurate client records and ensure confidentiality of sensitive financial information.

Stay current on tax law changes and filing requirements.

Required Qualifications

description:

The bar here is strategic ownership of the build, not waiting for a backlog to be handed to you.

Work hours are flexible but need to overlap with our team between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM EST during active project work. Just want to make sure you can meet inside that window.

- A strategy-first approach. You're someone who shows up with the plan and tells us what we should be building, testing, and improving. You partner with our team on execution, but you lead the thinking on your work.

- Deep comfort with Claude Code, GitHub, Supabase, Vercel, working with APIs, and the GoHighLevel API. We're also genuinely interested in whatever else you've built your workflow around.

- A real love for this work. That comes through fast in conversation, and we'd rather hire someone who has it than someone who's just qualified.



How to Apply



A few things we'd love you to do, in order:



1. Please start your reply with the word "Jamal." We use this as a small check to spot applicants who read instructions carefully. Without it, we won't be able to review your application.



2. Record a 5-minute video answering the questions below. No script needed. We just want to get a feel for how you think.



3. Share your full tool stack with self-ratings (1 to 10). These ones we already know we need:

   - Claude Code    /10

   - What was the outcome? Where were they when you started, and where are they now?

   - If you have current clients, where are those projects today?



   We're trying to understand how you measure your own impact. The more specific, the better.



5. Quick confirmation that you can work somewhere inside the hours described above.



How You Use AI



In your video, spend a minute or so on this. The more specific the better:



- Which AI tools you use daily, weekly, and occasionally

- A specific example of a build task in this role where AI saves you real time, and how you use it

- A time AI gave you a wrong or bad output. How you caught it, and what you did about it

- Anything you've intentionally chosen NOT to let AI do in your work, and why



We're looking for real, lived examples. The specifics tell the story.



A Few Questions for Your Video



Take these in order, and just talk through them naturally.



1. If you came on next week and we asked you to build out our internal tooling, walk us through your first 30 days. What would you want to look at, what would you build first, and how would you d
 the order?

2. We hand you a vague request like "we need something to make X less painful," with no spec. Walk us through how you go from that sentence to a shipped tool.

3. An automation you built has started silently failing in production. Walk us through what you check first and how you track it down.

4. Why do you love building this kind of thing? Tell us about a recent tool or automation you shipped that reminded you why you do this work.

5. What's something about building with Claude Code, MCP, or agentic workflows that's changed in the last year that you've actually adjusted your approach around?

title: Performance Video Editor
description:
**Performance Video Editor**



**Remote — Australia (Melbourne-based team) | Full-time, 38 hours/week AEST**



---



### **Not all editors make ads. The best ones make blinds look like the most exciting thing on the feed.**



We're 5 Minute Blinds. We sell custom-made blinds and curtains that Australians can measure, order, and install themselves in minutes, not weeks. We don't sell window coverings. We sell **taste**.



We're looking for a Performance Video Editor who can turn fabric, light, and transformation into scroll-stopping creative that actually drives sales.



---



About Us



We're a Melbourne-based DTC brand reshaping how Australians buy window furnishings. Custom-made, expertly crafted right here in Australia, designed to be installed by anyone with a cordless drill.



We're growing fast across Meta, TikTok, Google, and Pinterest. Every room transformation, install demo, and fabric close-up is an opportunity to win a customer — and we need an editor who treats it that way.



The Role



This isn't a "make it look pretty" editing role. You'll sit at the intersection of creative and conversion, cutting video that stops 



thumbs mid-scroll, drives new customer acquisition, and helps us achieve our mission of becoming the experts in the window furnishings industry.



You'll work directly with our performance marketing team, turning campaign data into creative decisions and shipping new ad variants at the pace performance media demands.



What You'll Actually Do



Turn performance data into visual strategy by working with the paid media team to understand what's converting (and what isn't), then design edits that double down on what works



Edit conversion-focused video across Meta, TikTok, Reels, YouTube, Shorts, Pinterest, and Google — optimised for each platform's aspect ratios, sound conventions, and viewer behaviour



Master the 3-second hook — our products are visual, but the feed requires virality. You'll craft openings that earn the next 30 seconds



Rapidly iterate and A/B test design concepts based on performance data and real-time campaign feedback



Design scroll-stopping videos and motion graphics that capture attention within 3 seconds and drive engagement



Participate in creative reviews to analyse top-performing creative elements and extract replicable design principles



Multiply creative output through AI tools — leverage cutting-edge AI technologies to enhance asset generation and production efficiency



Meet performance benchmarks including click-through rates, engagement rates, and conversion metrics across all campaigns



Deliver assets on deadline while maintaining quality standards and organised documentation systems





What Sets You Apart



Proven experience — Minimum of 2–3 years in a similar role. You've got a strong grasp of design fundamentals and know your way around Adobe Creative Cloud.



You analyse data before designing — You don't just want to know what looks good; you want to know what converts and why



You've mastered rapid iteration — You can produce multiple high-quality variants quickly, not precious about your work



You understand the psychology behind conversions — You know why certain visuals trigger action and how to implement those principles



You can translate performance metrics into design decisions — CTR, Hook Rate & CVR aren't just acronyms to you; they're design briefs



You think like a growth marketer, not just a designer — You care about business outcomes, not just aesthetics



You make decisions fast — You're comfortable with speed, can manage multiple projects, and deliver quality under tight deadlines





Why Join Us



Real ownership of a fast-growing brand — your edits will be seen by hundreds of thousands of Australians every week, and you'll see the revenue impact in real time



Work with purpose, ideas become reality — Create assets that drive real business results. We celebrate bold work and strong concepts get implemented quickly.



Learn constantly — Gain expertise across multiple platforms and industries. Receive honest input that drives improvement through open discussion.



Creative autonomy — We'll give you the problem, not micromanage your process

Flexible work arrangements — Fully remote with core hours for team collaboration. Focus on results, not desk time, with freedom to structure your day.



Supportive team culture full of A-players — Our rigorous hiring ensures everyone on the team is exceptional while ensuring we win as a team.



Performance-based rewards — We recognise and compensate exceptional results

Growth opportunity, collaborative environment — Help shape our creative approach as we expand. Knowledge sharing without creative politics or egos.





Ready to Prove You're in the Top 1%?



Our hiring process is built to identify exceptional talent — quickly.



Apply with your resume, a cover letter, and a portfolio or reel of performance work. Please link to actual ads that ran, not just brand films or spec work.



Applications without a portfolio will not be accepted.



To confirm you've read this entire job description, please include the word BLUE somewhere in your cover letter.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to record a short 3–5 minute video walking us through the following:



- Introduce yourself — Tell us who you are and what kind of creative work you've been doing for the last 12 months, specifically anything in the DTC or ecomm space.

- Show us something you edited that actually ran as a paid ad — Talk us through what you were trying to achieve in the first 3 seconds and whether it worked. Share the results or any client feedback you received.

- What's one thing most video editors get wrong when they're cutting ads for ecomm brands, and how do you approach it differently?



No fancy production required — we're looking for clear thinking, not polish.

Finalists join us for a portfolio review and creative strategy conversation.

We're 5 Minute Blinds. We sell custom-made blinds and curtains that Australians can measure, order, and install themselves in minutes, not weeks. We don't sell window coverings. We sell taste.

We're looking for a Performance Video Editor who can turn fabric, light, and transformation into scroll-stopping creative that actually drives sales.



About Us

We're a Melbourne-based DTC brand reshaping how Australians buy window furnishings. Custom-made, expertly crafted right here in Australia, designed to be installed by anyone with a cordless drill.

We're growing fast across Meta, TikTok, Google, and Pinterest. Every room transformation, install demo, and fabric close-up is an opportunity to win a customer — and we need an editor who treats it that way.



The Role

This isn't a "make it look pretty" editing role. You'll sit at the intersection of creative and conversion, cutting video that stops thumbs mid-scroll, drives new customer acquisition, and helps us achieve our mission of becoming the experts in the window furnishings industry.

You'll work directly with our performance marketing team, turning campaign data into creative decisions and shipping new ad variants at the pace performance media demands.



What You'll Actually Do



Turn performance data into visual strategy by working with the paid media team to understand what's converting (and what isn't), then design edits that double down on what works

Edit conversion-focused video across Meta, TikTok, Reels, YouTube, Shorts, Pinterest, and Google — optimised for each platform's aspect ratios, sound conventions, and viewer behaviour

Master the 3-second hook — our products are visual, but the feed requires virality. You'll craft openings that earn the next 30 seconds

Rapidly iterate and A/B test design concepts based on performance data and real-time campaign feedback

Design scroll-stopping videos and motion graphics that capture attention within 3 seconds and drive engagement

Participate in creative reviews to analyse top-performing creative elements and extract replicable design principles

Multiply creative output through AI tools — leverage cutting-edge AI technologies to enhance asset generation and production efficiency

Meet performance benchmarks including click-through rates, engagement rates, and conversion metrics across all campaigns

Deliver assets on deadline while maintaining quality standards and organised documentation systems





What Sets You Apart



Proven experience — Minimum of 2–3 years in a similar role. You've got a strong grasp of design fundamentals and know your way around Adobe Creative Cloud.

You analyse data before designing — You don't just want to know what looks good; you want to know what converts and why

You've mastered rapid iteration — You can produce multiple high-quality variants quickly, not precious about your work

You understand the psychology behind conversions — You know why certain visuals trigger action and how to implement those principles

You can translate performance metrics into design decisions — CTR, Hook Rate & CVR aren't just acronyms to you; they're design briefs

You think like a growth marketer, not just a designer — You care about business outcomes, not just aesthetics

You make decisions fast — You're comfortable with speed, can manage multiple projects, and deliver quality under tight deadlines





Why Join Us



Real ownership of a fast-growing brand — your edits will be seen by hundreds of thousands of Australians every week, and you'll see the revenue impact in real time

Work with purpose, ideas become reality — Create assets that drive real business results. We celebrate bold work and strong concepts get implemented quickly.

Learn constantly — Gain expertise across multiple platforms and industries. Receive honest input that drives improvement through open discussion.

Creative autonomy — We'll give you the problem, not micromanage your process

Flexible work arrangements — Fully remote with core hours for team collaboration. Focus on results, not desk time, with freedom to structure your day.

Supportive team culture full of A-players — Our rigorous hiring ensures everyone on the team is exceptional while ensuring we win as a team.

Performance-based rewards — We recognise and compensate exceptional results

Growth opportunity, collaborative environment — Help shape our creative approach as we expand. Knowledge sharing without creative politics or egos.





Ready to Prove You're in the Top 1%?

Our hiring process is built to identify exceptional talent — quickly.

Apply with your resume, a cover letter, and a portfolio or reel of performance work. Please link to actual ads that ran, not just brand films or spec work.



Applications without a portfolio will not be accepted.



To confirm you've read this entire job description, please include the word BLUE somewhere in your cover letter.



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to record a short 3–5 minute video walking us through the following:



Introduce yourself — Tell us who you are and what kind of creative work you've been doing for the last 12 months, specifically anything in the DTC or ecomm space.

Show us something you edited that actually ran as a paid ad — Talk us through what you were trying to achieve in the first 3 seconds and whether it worked. Share the results or any client feedback you received.

What's one thing most video editors get wrong when they're cutting ads for ecomm brands, and how do you approach it differently?



No fancy production required — we're looking for clear thinking, not polish.

Finalists join us for a portfolio review and creative strategy conversation.

title: Finance Director
description:
This is a chance to do high-grade finance work for some of the most exciting growth companies in the CPG and DTC space. You will sit close to the founders and operators building category-defining brands, owning the financial data, the modeling, and the analysis that shape how they plan, allocate capital, and scale.

It is a senior, hands-on role for someone who takes real ownership of the numbers and keeps them clean, current, and decision-ready week to week. You should be equally comfortable building a three-statement model from scratch and tracing the margin implications of a new vendor contract, and you should get energy from seeing your work drive real decisions across a portfolio of brands.



1. Financial Data, Reporting, and Margins

•        Own weekly financial data management across the portfolio, tracking performance and margins, not just the monthly close, so the numbers stay reliable enough to act on at any point in the cycle.

•        Ensure data integrity by working closely with our accounting and controllership teams on reconciliations and month-end close outputs, owning the reporting cadence end to end.

•        Develop and manage KPI dashboards, executive reporting packages, and board-ready materials.

•        Drive the detail underneath the numbers: unit economics, margin analysis, and demand planning, so the CFO can point to where margin is leaking and where it can be recovered.

2. Planning, Forecasting, and Modeling

•        Run planning cycles end to end: annual budgets, rolling forecasts, and ongoing variance analysis across a portfolio of clients.

•        Build and maintain dynamic 1, 3, and 5-year models, including three-statement models, scenario analyses, and sensitivity tables.

•        Translate complex financial data into clear, actionable insights for non-finance stakeholders.

3. CFO Pod Support and Client Coverage

•        Serve as the primary analytical partner to Client CFOs across multiple engagements.

•        Prepare materials and analysis ahead of board meetings, investor calls, and strategic planning sessions.

•        Support client meetings alongside the CFO, and over time step into functional conversations with heads of marketing, supply chain, and operations as trust is built.

•        Provide guidance and decision support on commercial questions including pricing, channel mix, inventory planning, and vendor terms.

4. Capital Markets and Strategic Support

•        Support fundraising and M&A processes by building investor materials, data rooms, credit packs, and diligence support.

•        Assist with capital allocation scenarios, cash runway planning, and lender and investor reporting packages.



What we're looking for:

Candidates must be comfortable working directly with CFOs and supporting multiple client engagements

•        6 to 8 years of progressive experience in FP&A, financial operations, or corporate finance, with a track record of owning planning cycles and recurring reporting end to end.

•        Senior FP&A or controllership-trained background. You are as comfortable with the integrity of the underlying data as with the model built on top of it.

•        Prior experience in a multi-client or portfolio support role (fractional, consulting, PE operating, or multi-entity environment) is strongly preferred.

•        Deep understanding of consumer business models including DTC, retail, omnichannel, and wholesale.

•        Advanced financial modeling skills, including multi-year three-statement models and scenario analysis.

•        Strong working knowledge of accounting principles (accrual vs. cash, revenue recognition, COGS treatment, inventory accounting).

•        Experience with accounting platforms (QuickBooks Online, NetSuite, Xero) and BI or reporting tools.

•        Ability to synthesize complex data into clear, executive-ready insights and communicate with confidence to senior stakeholders.

•        Bonus: strong experience with LLMs (Claude, ChatGPT) and automation platforms.

•        Thrives in a lean, high-performance, distributed team environment.



Send your CV and explain why you're fit for the role.

mber

description:
**Podcast Manager & Growth Strategist** (Publishing • SEO • Monetization)

*Part-time / contract — Remote*



The Enlighten Up podcast is one of the main ways we reach and serve high-achieving, spiritually curious women — and we're looking for someone to take it to the next level. **Monetization**

- Build and grow revenue from the show: sponsorships, affiliate partnerships, and — most importantly — converting listeners into Enlighten Up programs, community, and products through clear calls to action and funnels.

- Track analytics and report monthly on growth, traffic sources, and revenue, with concrete recommendations.



**You bring**

- Proven experience growing a podcast and/or YouTube channel (views, subscribers, downloads — bring numbers).

- Strong command of SEO (podcast, video, and search) and audience-growth tactics.

- Experience with podcast hosting/distribution (Transistor a plus) and repurposing content for social.

- Sharp copywriting and an instinct for a warm, grounded, spiritually-minded brand voice.

- Monetization know-how — sponsorships, affiliates, and/or funneling audiences into digital products and programs.

 marketing (Klaviyo a plus); experience with membership or private podcast feeds.

Modern

Fast-paced when needed

title: Short-Form Video Editor + Social Media Poster (Instagram & TikTok), Part-Time, Long-Term
description:
About this role

Kucks Health is a US health and life insurance agency. The owner films on camera. I'm building the agency's Instagram and TikTok with founder-led short-form video, and I need one reliable person to handle everything after the camera: editing, posting, and engagement. This is part-time and long-term, paid based on experience, plus a $20 bonus for any video that passes 1 million views. Do great work and the role grows.



What you'll do

- Edit raw footage (filmed in monthly batches by me) into short-form videos for Reels and TikTok: strong hooks, captions and subtitles, b-roll, trending audio, clean pacing.

- Turn each batch into weeks of content. One filming session becomes many posts.

- Post consistently on both platforms, around 4 to 7 posts per week per platform, on a simple calendar.

- Daily engagement: reply to comments, like and follow relevant accounts, basic DM triage using my scripts.

- Pull in trending sounds and formats from the finance and insurance creator space.

- Send a short monthly report: views, follows, saves, shares, profile clicks, and any DMs or leads.



What I provide

- Logo and brand assets, a brand voice guide, a banned-words list, and DM response scripts.

- Monthly raw footage. Some AI tools already set up.



You must have

- Strong short-form editing in CapCut and/or Premiere or similar. Portfolio of Reels or TikToks required.

- Experience posting and growing Instagram and TikTok accounts. Send accounts you've handled and show proof of their follower growth.

- Strong written English for captions, hooks, and replies.

- A real feel for hooks and retention.

- Reliability. This runs on showing up daily.



Nice to have

- Finance, insurance, or founder-brand content experience.

- Canva design for thumbnails and static posts.

- Scheduling tools like Metricool, Later, or Buffer.



Important: regulated content

This is insurance content, so it follows compliance rules. No "guaranteed," "best," or "cheapest" wording. No insurance quotes or advice. No answering health or medical questions in comments or DMs. Those route to me. These rules protect the business license, so they're not optional.



How to apply (read closely)

1. Start your message with the word TRUST so I know you read the post.

2. Send 2 to 3 links to short-form videos you personally edited.

3. Send 1 to 2 Instagram or TikTok accounts you've posted for or grown, with screenshots proving the follower growth (before and after).

4. In one or two sentences, what would you post in week one for a health and life insurance agency just starting out?

5. Why should I hire you? What makes you different from every other editor and content manager applying, and how do I know I can depend on you?

Applications missing these steps get skipped.

title: Customer Support Representative (CSR)
description:
Please read the full job description below before applying.

This role requires a written application AND a 3-minute video. If you only apply through the job board, your application will not be reviewed.

The full application takes about 15 minutes.

Step 1 — Complete the application form: 

Step 2 — Submit a 3-minute video answering ALL THREE questions. Upload to Google Drive (set to "anyone with the link"), Loom, or YouTube (unlisted), and paste the link into the application form.

Videos longer than 4 minutes will not be reviewed. Videos that don't answer all three questions will not be reviewed.

Question 1: Walk us through a time you handled an upset customer. What was the problem, what did you say, and how did it end?

Question 2: A client calls and says "the cleaners missed the bathrooms again — this is the third time." Talk to us as if we're that client. We want to hear your tone, your empathy, and how you take ownership.

Question 3: Walk me through the Customer Support role from your background that's most relevant to this one. Why does it line up? How long were you there, what did your day-to-day look like, what KPIs were you measured on, and how did you perform against them?

Real examples only. No scripts read off a page.



Compensation & Logistics

•	Compensation: 1,200 - 1,500 CAD

•	Location: Fully remote. Reliable internet with a backup connection required for if your primary goes down.

•	Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Mountain Time (Edmonton, Alberta).

•	Reports to: Client Services Manager



About One Janitorial

One Janitorial is a commercial cleaning company operating across Canada with active US expansion. We manage roughly 700 clients and 180+ alliance partners through a 36-person fully remote team. We're scaling toward $11–12M in revenue in 2027.

We don't clean buildings ourselves. We sell commercial cleaning contracts to businesses — medical clinics, offices, retail, warehouses, restaurants — and match them to local cleaning alliances who do the work. Sales puts the contracts on the board. You keep those clients happy, supported, and with us for years.

We live by one rule: over promise, over deliver. When a client has a problem, how fast and how well you respond is what keeps them. That's your job.



The Role

You are the first point of contact when a client has an issue. You take inbound complaints and questions, you own the problem until it's solved, and you coordinate with our cleaning alliances to make sure the fix actually happens. You report directly to the Client Services Manager.

You are the voice of One Janitorial to hundreds of clients. When something goes wrong, you're the person who makes it right — calmly, quickly, and completely.

This is a role for someone who genuinely likes helping people, stays calm under pressure, and follows through until the loop is closed.



What You'll Actually Do

1. Handle client issues and complaints

You'll field inbound calls,
s, and tickets from clients. You will:

•	Respond fast — clients need to hear from a real person quickly

•	Listen, take ownership, and de-escalate when someone is frustrated

•	Communicate the solution the same day and the permanent fix by the next scheduled clean

2. Coordinate fixes with our alliances

You don't clean — but you make sure it gets cleaned right. You will:

•	Reach out to the cleaning alliance responsible and communicate exactly what needs to happen

•	Follow up to confirm the fix was actually done

•	Keep the client updated so they're never left wondering

3. Manage your tickets in HubSpot

•	Log every issue, conversation, and resolution

title: Accounting Assistant
description:
One Janitorial — Remote, Full-time, Contract



How to Apply

Please read the full job description below before applying.

This role requires a written application AND a 3-minute video. If you only apply through the job board, your application will not be reviewed.



The full application takes about 15 minutes.

Step 1 — Complete the application form: 

Step 2 — Submit a 3-minute video answering ALL THREE questions. Upload to Google Drive (set to "anyone with the link"), Loom, or YouTube (unlisted), and paste the link into the application form.

Videos longer than 4 minutes will not be reviewed. Videos that don't answer all three questions will not be reviewed.

Question 1: Walk us through your experience in QuickBooks. What did you use it for day to day — payroll, reconciliation, AR, AP — and how comfortable are you across the full platform?

Question 2: Talk us through how you'd reconcile a month of transactions when the books don't balance. Where do you start, how do you find the discrepancy, and how do you make sure it doesn't happen again? We want to hear how you think through a problem.

Question 3: Walk me through the accounting role from your background that's most relevant to this one. Why does it line up? How long were you there, what did your day-to-day look like, what were you responsible for, and how did you perform against it?

Real examples only. No scripts read off a page.

Compensation & Logistics

Compensation: 50,000 to 66,000

Location: Fully remote. Reliable internet with a backup connection required for if your primary goes down.

Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Mountain Time (Edmonton, Alberta).

Reports to: Accounting Manager

About One Janitorial

One Janitorial is a commercial cleaning company operating across Canada with active US expansion. We manage roughly 700 clients and 180+ alliance partners through a 36-person fully remote team. We're scaling toward $11–12M in revenue in 2027.

We don't clean buildings ourselves. We sell commercial cleaning contracts to businesses — medical clinics, offices, retail, warehouses, restaurants — and match them to local cleaning alliances who do the work. Behind all of it is a finance function that has to be accurate, on time, and clean. That's where you come in.

We move fast and we run lean. Our books have to be right, our people have to be paid, and our receivables have to be collected — on time, every time.

RESPONSIBILITIES

•	Manage accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR) processes accurately and on time.

•	Perform bank, credit card, and account reconciliations to ensure financial records are accurate.

•	Process payroll and maintain payroll records in compliance with company policies.

•	Investigate and resolve discrepancies in financial transactions and account balances.

•	Maintain accurate bookkeeping records using QuickBooks.

•	Prepare and review financial reports, invoices, and supporting documentation.

•	Monitor outstanding receivables and assist with collections activities.

•	Ensure all accounting transactions are recorded correctly and according to established procedures.

•	Support month-end and year-end closing processes.

•	Collaborate with the Accounting Manager and other departments to improve financial processes and reporting accuracy.

•	Maintain organized financial records and documentation for audit and compliance purposes.

•	Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and prevent recurring accounting errors.

QUALIFICATIONS

•	Proven experience in bookkeeping, accounting, accounts payable, accounts receivable, or a related finance role.

•	Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks, including reconciliation, AP, AR, payroll, and reporting functions.

•	Experience performing bank and credit card reconciliations.

•	Understanding of basic accounting principles and financial reporting.

•	High attention to detail and strong accuracy when handling financial data.

•	Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.

•	Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

•	Strong organizational and time-management skills.

•	Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets.

•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

•	Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

•	Reliable internet connection with a backup connection available.

•	Experience supporting month-end close processes is an asset.

•	Experience in service-based businesses or multi-location operations is an advantage

Benefits:

•	What is the largest number of transactions you have reconciled in a single month?

MyoBloom



About MyoBloom

MyoBloom is a content, services, and education platform built for orofacial myofunctional therapists (OMTs) — healthcare providers who specialize in the way the mouth and face muscles function. We help OMT practices run more organized, professional, and sustainable businesses through templates, systems, coaching, and done-for-you services.

We are launching a social media management service specifically for OMT practices and are building a small team of skilled freelance social media managers to deliver it. This is a niche, field-specific role — you will be writing and designing content for a specialized healthcare audience, using a well-documented system with real support behind it.



The Role

You will manage the social media content for a small roster of assigned OMT practice clients. That means designing posts in Canva, writing captions with AI tool support, scheduling content in GoHighLevel, sending posts for client approval, and attending a short weekly team check-in. All content is reviewed by a myofunctional therapist on staff before going live, so clinical accuracy is supported — but you are responsible for quality, consistency, and deadlines.

This is a freelance position paid on a per-client monthly basis. Your rate is approximately $6.75/hour equivalent, calculated by client tier and weekly post volume. As you're skills and understanding of the field grows, so does your pay (less need for auditing).

Use ChatGPT for image generation when custom visuals are needed

Schedule content in GoHighLevel Social Planner for approval

Attend a 15-minute weekly tea
eting every Tuesday at 11am PST / 2pm EST

Keep all files named and organized according to MyoBloom's naming system

Canva — specifically social media design using templates, brand kits, and folder organization

Claude AI — experience accessing and prompting within a project or structured workspace

ChatGPT — specifically image generation capability

eting

, and AI tools

title: Daily Bookkeeping Coordinator (Philippines Remote)
description:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Bookkeeper to manage real-time transaction entry, sales

reconciliation, and financial analysis across multiple company entities. This part-time role serves

as a critical partner to our executive team, providing daily transaction accuracy, proactive

anomaly detection, and weekly strategic spending insights. The ideal candidate is an experienced

bookkeeping professional who combines meticulous transaction management with analytical

insight into business spending patterns and revenue trends.



Key Responsibilities

Daily Transaction Management

Update all transactions across all company entities in QuickBooks on a daily basis

Reconcile transactions against bank and credit card statements each day

Add detailed memos and descriptions to every transaction following the company's

established format and naming conventions

Ensure all transactions are properly coded and categorized before reconciliation closes



Receipt & Invoice Processing

Upload receipts from the CC expense tracking sheet into QuickBooks

Upload invoices from the shared Google folder into QuickBooks

Flag missing documentation - proactively notify leadership when receipts or invoices are

missing for recorded transactions

Verify receipt/invoice matches to corresponding transactions and flag discrepancies



Sales Deposit Reconciliation

Reconcile daily Shopify payment deposits using journal entries (J/E) to provide clear

visibility

Break out Shopify deposits into component parts:



Gross sales by channel

Shopify payment processing fees

Shipping costs

Returns/refunds

Other adjustments as needed

Ensure each J/E reflects the actual flow of funds and matches bank deposits exactly




 Monitoring & Review

Monitor all 
 activity daily - review pending bills, invoices, and payment activity

Verify vendor bills are accurate, properly coded, and match supporting invoices

Flag discrepancies - duplicate bills, incorrect amounts, or missing documentation

Escalate for approval - prepare bills with analysis for leadership approval (approval

authority will be delegated as trust is established)

Monitor payment status - ensure scheduled payments process correctly and flag failed

transactions



Payroll Verification

VerifyADP payroll deposits post correctly each pay period

Confirm amounts match expected payroll calculations and prior pay periods

Flag discrepancies - incorrect amounts, late deposits, or failed transactions

Reconcile payroll entries to bank deposits and QBO records



Weekly Financial Review & Analysis

Analyze spending patterns - prepare a weekly spending recap comparing current week to

same week in previous months

Identify high-spend outliers - flag vendors or expense categories exceeding typical spend

with context and explanation

Monitor revenue health - analyze daily sales deposits and flag revenue that's lower than

historical patterns

Investigate anomalies - dig into unusual fees, chargebacks, refunds, or payment processor

issues



Provide actionable insights - present findings in a format that supports executive decision-

making



Flag financial risks - alert leadership immediately to potential issues (large unexplained

transactions, unusual patterns, missing documentation)



Required Qualifications



5+ years of professional bookkeeping experience - proven track record managing multi-

entity accounting



Expert-level QuickBooks proficiency - advanced user with deep knowledge of transaction

coding and reconciliation

Journal entry mastery - comfortable with complex entries including depreciation, accruals,

revenue recognition, and sales breakdown

Financial analysis capability - able to identify spending trends, anomalies, and variance

from historical patterns

Advanced reconciliation skills - bank, credit card, and multi-platform sales deposit

reconciliation

Independent judgment - makes coding decisions and flags exceptions without prompting

Proactive communication - identifies and escalates issues before they become problems

Process mastery - learns and adheres to company-specific accounting procedures and

formatting standards

Daily availability - reliable execution of daily transaction uploads and reconciliation

Google Suite proficiency - comfortable with Drive, Sheets, and Forms for document

management



Preferred Qualifications

E-commerce accounting expertise - deep experience with Shopify, Amazon Seller Central,

marketplace reconciliation, and payment processor accounting

Bookkeeping certification - CPA, bookkeeping designation, or equivalent formal credential

Advanced Excel skills - pivot tables, VLOOKUP, macros for financial analysis

FP&A or financial analysis background - experience preparing variance analysis and trend

reporting

Multiple platform experience - proficiency with 
, Stripe, PayPal, or similar financial

tools

Senior bookkeeper or accounting manager background - led bookkeeping functions or

managed accounting teams



Tools & Platforms

You will work with:



QuickBooks (primary accounting system)


 (vendor invoices and payments)

ADP (payroll verification)

Shopify (sales deposit reconciliation)

Google Drive (invoices and supporting documents)

Google Sheets (expense tracking and reporting)

Google Forms (CC pre-approval workflow)

Bank portals (statement review and reconciliation)



Communication & Reporting

Language: English (fluent written communication required)

Weekly reports: Submit spending recap and revenue flags by end of week

Daily documentation: Flag missing receipts/invoices the same day they're identified

Ad hoc updates: Notify leadership immediately of significant discrepancies (e.g., large

unexplained deposits/withdrawals, missing major invoices)



Time Commitment & Compensation

5 hours per week (~20 hours per month)

Flexible schedule - work during your preferred hours within Philippine business time

$10 USD per hour

Total monthly compensation: ~$200 USD



Success Metrics

You'll be successful in this role if you:

?Independently manage 100% of daily transaction accuracy across all entities with zero

errors

?Monitor and review 
 daily - flag discrepancies and prepare for approval

escalation

?Verify Shopify deposits reconcile correctly and post as proper J/E breakouts

?Confirm ADP payroll deposits match expectations without errors

?Identify spending anomalies before leadership asks (proactive analysis, not reactive)



?Provide weekly insights that leadership acts on - your analysis drives decisions

?Make sound independent coding decisions that align with company standards and

accounting principles

?Catch control issues, missing documentation, and discrepancies immediately

?Deliver professional, actionable weekly reporting consistently and on time

?Require minimal supervision - execute autonomously with high-level guidance only



About This Role

Strategic daily engagement - This is not data entry; you're the first line of financial control

and analysis

Part-time structure appeals to experienced professionals - Ideal for senior bookkeepers

seeking flexible US-based engagement

High-impact analysis - Your weekly insights directly inform leadership decisions on

spending and cash flow

Independent expertise - You work autonomously; leadership trusts your judgment on

coding, reconciliation, and anomaly flagging

Quality over volume - 5 focused hours per week delivering expert-level work, not 20 hours

of junior-level task completion

Your accuracy matters - clean daily entries prevent month-end problems and provide real-

time visibility





TO BE CONSIDERED:

1. A link to your resume

2. Application Assessment 

Please answer the following question (
words). Your response will help us understand how you approach accuracy, problem-solving, and proactive communication.



Scenario:

You're reviewing daily transactions in QuickBooks and notice the following:



A credit card statement shows a $450 charge from "Office Supplies Co." that posted to QBO, but you cannot find a corresponding receipt in the CC expense tracking sheet or shared Google folder.

A Shopify deposit of $1,200 came in today, but when you break it out into sales, fees, and other components, the math doesn't match the previous week's pattern. This week shows much higher processing fees than usual.

You notice a credit card purchase of $2,100 to an unfamiliar vendor ("TechSoft Solutions Inc.") that appears to have been charged without going through the CC pre-approval form. When you check the expense sheet, there's no approval record for this purchase.

What would you do?



Which of these three items would you address first, and why?

Describe the specific steps you would take to resolve each issue

Who would you communicate with and what would you say?

How would you document your findings for leadership review?

title: Architectural Technician / 3D Modeller — ArchiCAD (Full-Time, UK Residential Practice)
description:
About us:

James Williamson Architects is a residential architecture practice based in Surrey, UK, working on high-end home extensions, renovations and new builds. We run a small remote team — most of it based in the Philippines — to a clear house standard in ArchiCAD 26. You'd work directly with the practice owner and our senior technician.



The role:

We're looking for a reliable, full-time ArchiCAD technician to model and visualise residential projects, fro
asured surveys through to design options. You'll build accurate existing-conditions models, develop renovation and extension options, and produce clean visuals for client presentations — all to our standard template and detail library. This is a long-term position, not casual or project-by-project work.

ArchiCAD proficiency is essential. It is the core skill for this role and will be tested at application stage. If you are not confident and fast in ArchiCAD, this role isn't for you.



What you'll do:

Build accurate as-built (existing-conditions) models in ArchiCAD fro
asured survey data

Reconcile discrepancies between survey information and the model

Develop design, renovation and extension options

Produce 3D visualisations and renders for client presentations (Enscape)

Work to our standard template, ArchiCAD library, finishes and house style

Keep files organised and share daily progress via Google Drive

Track your time via Hubstaff

Communicate clearly and flag issues early



You must have:

Strong, demonstrable ArchiCAD proficiency (ideally ArchiCAD 26) — modelling, layouts, library and object management

The ability to read measured surveys and translate them into accurate models

A good eye for spatial accuracy and residential interiors

Excellent written English and proactive communication

Self-management — you meet deadlines without being chased

A capable workstation and stable internet



Nice to have:

Enscape (or similar) rendering experience

UK or European residential project experience

An interest in growing into more technical, comprehensive project work over time



Hours & availability:

This is a full-time role (around 40 hours per week), Monday to Friday. We need a consistent daily schedule with a reliable overlap into UK working hours — your day should reach at least early afternoon UK time (around 14:00 UK / 21:00 Philippine time). Reliability and consistency are non-negotiable: please only apply if you can commit to full-time, regular weekday hours for the long term.



Salary:

Importivity is building an internal AI-powered operations ecosystem: specialized agents, business automations, lead intelligence, and content workflows that run real business processes every day. PLEASE only apply if you are truly passionate about creating a career. We have a very low turnover rate, and many of our employees and partners have been with us for 5+ years. We all prefer to work with people who take their responsibilities seriously. Please only apply if you are confident you can meet and exceed expectations. Read job description carefully please.

Time Zone: Central Time Zone (HQ Austin, Texas)

Hours per week: 40

Holidays: PAID







What you'll build...

Agents that analyze
s, client communications, and meeting transcripts, extract requirements, and generate RFQs, order forms, and operational docs, flagging missing info and asking for clarification automatically.



Workflows that research and enrich prospects, analyze their online presence, and score them against campaign requirements to drive outbound performance.



Systems that sync Google Drive and ClickUp, organize assets, and manage production and publishing pipelines.



Multi-agent workflows, tool integrations, retrieval systems, and internal AI assistants.



Required skills..

Python: API integrations, background jobs, data processing, production debugging, and clean, maintainable code.



AI/LLMs: hands-on with OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, or Gemini, plus prompt engineering, structured outputs, function calling, tool use, agent workflows, and RAG.



Full stack: comfortable understanding and modifying full-stack systems (frontend fundamentals, backend, databases, auth, 

API design, deployment). You don't need to be a frontend specialist.



Integrations: Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive APIs), ClickUp, webhooks, and third-party APIs.



Databases: PostgreSQL, Supabase, vector databases, and data modeling.





Nice to have...

LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, MCP servers, Docker, cloud infrastructure, Next.js/React, and experience with lead gen or content management systems.





Who we're looking for...

We care more about capability and mindset than credentials. You build projects outside of work, learn new tools fast, think like an owner, and work independently. You understand both the engineering and the business impact, and you want to grow into a senior AI systems builder.





How to apply...

Show us what you've built: relevant AI projects, automation systems, agents or workflows, your GitHub if you have one, and a short note on the most technically challenging project you've worked on. What you've built matters far more than formal qualifications.

title: Data Analyst (Visualization & Statistics)
description:
We are looking for a Data Analyst with strong visualization and statistical skills to turn operational data into clear, actionable insights. This role focuses on building dashboards, analyzing trends, and supporting decision-making through data.

You will work with structured operational datasets from internal tracking systems and transform them into meaningful reports and visual dashboards. No prior domain experience is required — we will provide training on the business context.



Key Responsibilities

Analyze structured operational data to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies

Build and maintain dashboards and reports for operational and leadership teams

Translate raw data into clear KPIs and meaningful performance metrics

Perform statistical analysis to support decision-making and performance tracking

Design clear and effective visualizations that communicate insights simply

Work with stakeholders to refine reporting needs and define metrics

Clean, validate, and prepare datasets for analysis and reporting



Required Skills

Data Analysis

Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, formulas, charts, data cleaning)

Clear understanding of SQL, including filtering, aggregation (GROUP BY), and table joins (INNER, LEFT, RIGHT JOINs)

Ability to work with structured datasets (CSV, spreadsheets, tabular data)



Statistics (Required)

Strong understanding of descriptive statistics (mean, median, variance, standard deviation)

Ability to interpret data distributions and identify outliers

Basic trend and time-series analysis

Understanding of correlation vs causation

Ability to define, calculate, and interpret KPIs



Data Visualization

Experience building dashboards using:

Microsoft Power BI or Tableau

Ability to choose appropriate chart types for different types of insights

Strong visual storytelling skills (clarity, simplicity, and impact over complexity)

Experience designing dashboards for operational and management use



Analytical Thinking

Ability to break down problems into measurable data questions

Strong attention to detail and logical reasoning

Comfortable working with imperfect, incomplete, or inconsistent data

Ability to think critically about what the data is actually showing



Communication

Ability to explain insights clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Strong written summaries of findings and recommendations

Ability to translate business questions into data analysis tasks



Nice to Have (Optional)

Basic Python (pandas for data analysis and visualization)

Experience with simple automation or reporting workflows

Familiarity with APIs or data extraction methods

Basic understanding of time-based or geospatial data



What We Offer

Hands-on work with real operational data and dashboards

Training in domain-specific systems and datasets

Direct impact on operational decision-making

Opportunity to grow in analytics, BI, and data-driven operations



Role Summary

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, building clear dashboards, and applying statistical thinking to real-world operational problems. The focus is on clarity, insight, and decision support — not heavy data engineering or large-scale infrastructure.

title: Video Editor - Long Form Talking Head Youtube Editor
description:
We're looking for a skilled video editor to join REViVE Marketing Partners — a boutique Amazon marketing agency creating educational content for CPG brands and Amazon sellers.

This role is specifically for long-form YouTube content: 5–8 minute talking head, educational videos designed to build trust, teach, and retain viewers from start to finish. We publish consistently, and we need an editor who can match that pace without sacrificing quality.



What you'll be editing:

- 5–8 minute educational YouTube videos (talking head style)

- Content targeting Amazon sellers and eCommerce brand owners

- Occasional supporting graphics or visual assets



What we expect from your edits:

- Strong pacing — you know how to feel the rhythm of a video and cut accordingly

- Motion graphics and dynamic visuals that reinforce the content — not text slapped on a static background

- Clean, polished output that looks professional and on-brand every time

- Consistent quality across every video, not just your first one



Turnaround expectations:

First draft: 2–4 business days

Revisions: under 24 hours, every time



Responsiveness is non-negotiable:

You must be available for messaging Monday–Friday, 7 AM–4 PM CST

We expect a reply within 2 hours any time we reach out during those hours

If something comes up, you communicate proactively — you don't go quiet



You're a fit if you:

Have a portfolio of long-form talking head YouTube edits (5+ minutes)

Understand pacing intuitively — you watch the video, you feel where it drags, you fix it

Are comfortable with motion graphics beyond basic text animations

Take revision notes seriously and execute them fast

Work independently and don't need to be chased for updates



To Apply:

 

Your first line must include the word REViVE — applications that miss this will not be reviewed.

Please include:

- 1–2 sentences about yourself and your editing experience

- Links to similar long-form videos you've edited (talking head style, 5+ minutes)

- Editing and design tools you use

- Your typical turnaround time for a 5–8 minute video (first draft)

- Your typical response time M-F 7am-4pm cst

The majority of calls will be to warm leads already in the funnel, along with database contacts, past clients, prospects, and new lead opportunities. The right person knows how to build rapport quickly, ask strong questions, identify motivation, handle objections, and turn conversations into booked appointments.



**Responsibilities include:**



Calling and following up with warm leads already in the pipeline

Prospecting and identifying new lead opportunities

Managing and organizing the CRM

Tracking conversations, follow-up dates, notes, and lead status

Qualifying buyers and sellers based on motivation, timeline, and needs

Booking appointments for the Realtor

Creating structure around follow-up systems and sales processes

Maintaining consistent communication with prospects and clients

Keeping the sales pipeline active, organized, and moving forward

Taking initiative to improve lead management and conversion



**The ideal candidate is:**



Based in the Philippines and experienced working remotely

Experienced in phone sales, inside sales, appointment setting, real estate sales, or lead management

Confident, personable, and professional on the phone

Fluent in English with strong verbal and written communication skills

Self-motivated, hungry, and results-driven

Comfortable taking ownership without needing constant direction

Organized and disciplined with CRM follow-up

Strong at building rapport and uncovering client needs

Able to handle objections professionally

Proactive in creating systems, not just following them

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment

Available to work aligned hours with the Realtor’s time zone

Real estate experience is a strong asset



This role is best suited for someone who wants to be a key part of a growing real estate business, not just make calls from a script. You’ll have the opportunity to take the lead on improving the CRM, building a stronger follow-up process, and helping convert more opportunities into clients.
