title: Customer Success/Support Specialist
description:
IMPORTANT: Please read this posting in full before submitting.



Codes Health is a well-funded, fast-growing US startup building the modern platform for medical records retrieval. We work with law firms and specialty healthcare providers to get records faster, with zero errors.



This is not a traditional support role. You will be the primary point of contact between our customers and our internal records team — managing tasks, relaying information, and keeping things moving without being told twice.



Required Background — Please Do Not Apply Without This

- 2+ years in a medical BPO or healthcare admin role (medical records, billing, prior auth, ROI, claims, or similar)

- Near-native written and spoken English — grammar, spelling, and clarity must be excellent. Applications with grammar or spelling errors will not be reviewed.

- Comfortable on the phone with US-based offices

- Experience working with US clients in a remote setup



Before You Apply

As the first step in our process, we ask all applicants to send a short video recording (2–3 minutes max) answering the following three prompts:



1. Tell us about yourself — what kind of work you've done before, and why you're interested in this role.

2. Tell us about a mistake you made at work. What happened and what did you do about it?

3. Tell us about a time you improved a process at work. What did you change, and what was the result?



Applications without a video that answers these 3 questions, or from applicants without a medical BPO background, will not be reviewed.



What You'll Do

- Create and manage customer-facing tasks requesting specific documents or information

- Write clear, specific messages that leave no room for misinterpretation

- Monitor and respond to customer comments promptly and independently

- Relay documents and information between customers and the internal team with zero errors

- Track open tasks, follow up on outstanding items, and close completed work without being prompted

- Flag anything that looks off — wrong address, mismatched names, duplicate requests



What Success Looks Like

- Tasks move forward without unnecessary back and forth

- Customers are never asked for the same thing twice

- Your notes are always clear: who you spoke to, what they said, what you did, what happens next

- Zero items sitting idle without follow-up



What We're Looking For

- Near-perfect written English — grammar, spelling, and clarity are non-negotiable

- Extreme attention to detail — names, dates, addresses, document types

- Self-sufficient — you Google, check documentation, and use available resources before escalating

- Organized and reliable — able to manage multiple open tasks without dropping anything

- Comfortable working in task management tools, Slack, and

- Prior experience in customer support, admin coordination, or a similar detail-oriented role



This Role Is Not For You If

- You don't have a medical BPO or healthcare admin background

- You need manager approval before making routine decisions

- You write vague notes that require follow-up questions to understand

- You struggle with spelling, grammar, or written communication



Why Codes Health

- YC-backed, well-funded, generating revenue and growing fast

title: Remote Civil/Electrical Design Engineer — Site Civil, Stormwater & Mission-Critical Equipment Layout (U.S. Projects, U.S
description:
Good addition — but one scope judgment first, because it changes who you’re actually hiring.



Stormwater/site-civil and mission-critical power are two different disciplines. A civil engineer’s legitimate role with generators, MV/HV gear, and 480V is the site/civil side: equipment pads and foundations, fuel storage and secondary containment (SPCC), spill berms around transformers, equipment-yard grading and drainage, MV/HV duct bank and conduit routing layouts, NEC/NESC working-clearance and access geometry, and delivery/laydown access roads. That’s real and worth requiring.



What this person should not own is the electrical design — generator paralleling, switchgear sizing, load flow, and the MV-vs-480V topology. That’s electrical-EOR work and belongs in your MEP RFP track. Note for consistency: at 10 MW/site your campus distribution is MV (12.47 kV); 480V is the utilization/generator-output level, not the distribution backbone — so the posting should say “understands” 480V and MV equipment, not “designs the 480V distribution system.”



If you want one offshore hire wearing both hats, the practical version is a dual-discipline design engineer/drafter who does civil site work and electrical CAD (one-lines, equipment layouts, duct banks) under separate civil-PE and electrical-PE direction. Here’s that posting:



Job Posting (revised — copy/paste)



Title: Remote Civil/Electrical Design Engineer — Site Civil, Stormwater & Mission-Critical Equipment Layout (U.S. Projects, U.S. Hours)



About the role: We develop distributed digital-infrastructure (data center) campuses across rural Missouri. We need an experienced design engineer to produce site-civil, stormwater, and mission-critical equipment-siting deliverables for multiple ~5–50 acre campuses, each carrying standby generators, medium-voltage transformers, switchgear, and battery energy storage. Long-term, full-time, remote, working U.S. Central Time hours (8:00 AM–5:00 PM CT), under the direction of U.S.-licensed civil and electrical PEs who review and seal all permit submittals.



Responsibilities — Site Civil & Stormwater:



 • Grading, drainage, and site-development plans

 • Stormwater design: detention/retention basins, storm sewer, culverts, catch basins, hydraulic grade line checks

 • Pre/post-development runoff analysis (NRCS TR-55/TR-20, NOAA Atlas 14)

 • SWPPP and erosion/sediment control exhibits; earthwork and pipe sizing



Responsibilities — Mission-Critical Equipment Siting (civil/layout scope):



 • Equipment pad and foundation layouts for standby generators, MV transformers, switchgear, and BESS units

 • Fuel storage siting and secondary/spill containment (SPCC) design

 • Equipment-yard grading, drainage, and oil-water separation around HV/transformer areas

 • MV/HV and 480V duct bank, conduit, and cable-trench routing layouts

 • NEC working clearances and NESC high-voltage clearance/access geometry; equipment delivery and laydown access roads

 • Production of equipment layout drawings and electrical one-line drafting under an electrical PE’s direction



Nice to have: Data center / mission-critical / industrial site experience, Bluebeam Revu, GIS, U.S. county/state submittal sets, REVIT.

title: Expert Sales Representative / Closer (Credit Repair)
description:
# Expert Sales Representative / Closer for Credit Repair Company



## Position Type



Full-Time Remote Sales Position



## Company Overview



Bluprint Solutions Inc. is a credit repair, credit education, credit-building, and funding-readiness company helping clients improve their credit profiles, prepare for funding opportunities, and build stronger financial foundations.



We are looking for a highly skilled, experienced, and detail-oriented sales representative/closer who understands the credit repair industry and can confidently speak with leads, prequalify prospects, explain our programs, overcome objections, and close enrollments professionally.



This is a performance-driven role for someone who is confident on the phone, coachable, organized, and hungry to close.



## Job Responsibilities



The Sales Representative will be responsible for:



* Calling, texting, and following up with new leads daily

* Making a high volume of outbound calls, with a goal of 100+ dials per day

* Handling inbound leads from ads, social media, referrals, and other marketing channels

* Prequalifying prospects based on credit goals, current credit situation, funding goals, and readiness

* Explaining credit repair programs, client expectations, credit monitoring requirements, onboarding steps, and payment options

* Closing clients into the appropriate Bluprint Solutions program

* Creating payment plans and processing enrollments properly

* Managing follow-up inside CRM systems

* Handling objections with confidence and professionalism

* Maintaining accurate notes and client communication history

* Staying organized and following the company sales process

* Taking initiative daily without needing to be micromanaged



## Required Experience



The ideal candidate must have:



* Previous sales experience, preferably in credit repair, financial services, funding, coaching, consulting, or a similar industry

* Basic to strong knowledge of credit repair, credit reports, negative accounts, inquiries, collections, charge-offs, credit monitoring, and dispute expectations

* Experience closing clients over the phone

* Strong English communication skills

* Clear, professional phone presence and strong tonality

* Ability to build trust quickly with prospects

* Ability to listen carefully, ask the right questions, and recommend the right program

* Experience handling objections such as pricing, timing, trust, credit results, and hesitation

* Strong follow-up skills

* A coachable and trainable attitude

* High attention to detail

* Ability to work independently and take initiative



## Preferred Software Experience



Experience with the following tools is strongly preferred:



* GoHighLevel

* Credit Repair Cloud

* RingCentral or similar phone/dialer system

* 
, NMI, Stripe, or similar payment processor

* CRM pipelines, tags, tasks, notes, and lead follow-up systems



Training can be provided on company-specific systems, but applicants must already be comfortable working inside CRMs, dialers, and sales pipelines.



## What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* Confident but not pushy

* Professional and trustworthy on the phone

* A strong closer

* A great listener

* Detail-oriented

* Fast-moving and proactive

* Comfortable making a high volume of calls

* Able to follow scripts while still sounding natural

* Able to take feedback and improve quickly

* Serious about performance and results



This is not a position for someone who only wants to wait for leads to come in. There is always work to do, follow-up to complete, and opportunities to close.



## Compensation



Base pay will be discussed based on experience.



Performance-based bonuses and/or commission opportunities may be available for strong closers who meet sales goals and maintain quality standards.



## Application Instructions



To apply, please send the following:



1. Your resume

2. Details about any credit repair, financial services, or phone sales experience you have

3. A short voice sample introducing yourself and explaining why you believe you are a good fit for this position

4. Your availability and desired pay



## Voice Sample Instructions



Please record a short 60–90 second voice sample answering the following:



“Hi, my name is [Your Name]. I have experience in [your experience]. I believe I would be a great fit for this credit repair sales position because [explain why]. I am comfortable making outbound calls, following up with leads, handling objections, and closing clients professionally.”



Applicants who do not send a voice sample may not be considered.



## Screening Questions



Please answer the following when applying:



1. Have you ever worked in credit repair sales before? If yes, what was your role?

2. Are you comfortable making 100+ calls per day?

3. What CRM, dialer, or payment systems have you used before?

4. How do you typically handle a lead who says, “I need to think about it”?

5. Are you comfortable working in a performance-based sales environment?

6. What is your availability?

7. What is your desired hourly rate or base pay?



## Important



We are looking for a serious, long-term tea
mber who can help us grow, close leads, and represent the Bluprint Solutions brand professionally.

title: Remote Cold Caller for Trade Partner Outreach
description:
NOVA Signage is a leading provider of custom signage manufacturing solutions for sign shops, print shops, distributors, and trade buyers across North America. Our website serves as a B2B member login portal where we offer custom signage products, wholesale partner pricing, quote support, and production services designed to help our clients sell more signage products without expanding their own manufacturing capacity.



We are looking for a reliable B2B Outbound Caller / Lead Qualification Specialist to join our team. This is a remote, part-time position based in the Philippines, starting at 20 hours/week, with the potential to increase hours based on performance.

The cold callers should know how to professionally navigate gatekeepers, identify decision-makers, collect accurate details, and make meaningful business-to-business calls. 



This is not a hard-selling role. Your main responsibility is to call sign shops and printing shops in North America, identify the right contact person, collect accurate information, and confirm whether they are interested in receiving a NOVA trade sample kit. Our internal sales team will handle qualified leads and follow-up conversations.



Responsibilities



Call sign shops, print shops, and commercial signage companies in North America.

Identify the right decision maker, such as owner, general manager, production manager, estimator, purchasing manager, or operations manager.

Confirm whether the company is a good fit for NOVA’s wholesale/custom signage manufacturing services.

Collect accurate contact information, including contact name, role,
 address, phone number, company website, and shipping address.

Ask qualified prospects whether they are interested in receiving a NOVA trade sample kit.

Record call results clearly and accurately in our CRM, Google Sheet, or lead tracking system.

Follow a simple calling script and qualification process.

Handle gatekeepers professionally and politely.

Update lead status after every call, such as wrong number, not qualified, decision maker found,
 collected, sample kit approved, follow-up needed, or not interested.

Escalate interested prospects to the NOVA sales team for follow-up.

Maintain a professional, calm, and friendly tone on all calls.



Qualifications

3+ years of experience in outbound calling, appointment setting, telemarketing, lead generation, or B2B prospecting.

Experience calling businesses in the United States or Canada.

Excellent spoken English with a clear, neutral, and professional accent.

Strong listening skills and attention to detail.

Ability to follow a script without sounding robotic.

Comfortable speaking with receptionists, gatekeepers, owners, managers, and purchasing contacts.

Able to collect and enter information accurately.

Reliable internet connection and quiet working environment.

Basic computer skills, including Google Sheets, CRM systems,
, and online phone platforms.

Fluent in spoken and written English.

Ability to commit to 20 hours per week.

Must be available Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM Pacific Time.



Good to Have

Experience with B2B appointment setting for U.S. companies.

Experience with CRM tools such as HubSpot, Zoho, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or similar platforms.

Experience using online phone systems such as OpenPhone, Aircall, JustCall, RingCentral, or similar tools.

Experience in signage, printing, construction, manufacturing, wholesale, or B2B services.

Experience working night shift or U.S. business hours from the Philippines.

Comfortable using call recording, call notes, and lead qualification workflows.



What You Are Not Required to Do

You do not need to close sales.

You do not need to negotiate prices.

You do not need to provide technical product advice.

You do not need to promise lead times, warranty terms, or pricing.

You do not need to run long sales presentations.

Your goal is to identify the right person, confirm interest, collect accurate information, and pass qualified leads to our internal sales team.



How We Work

We offer a highly entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and operational work environment.

We prioritize action over discussion, and we value reliability, clear communication, accuracy, and a growth-oriented mindset.

Feedback is given openly and regularly to encourage continuous improvement.

We value people who are consistent, honest, detail-oriented, and easy to train.

This role is measured by call quality, accuracy of information, qualified contacts found, sample kit interest confirmed, and clean daily reporting.

Work Schedule

Part-time: 20 hours per week

4 hours per day, 5 days per week



Monday to Friday

9:00 AM – 1:00 PM Pacific Time (Tues-Sat 12:00 AM – 4:00 AM Manila Time)

This schedule requires working during North American business hours. In the Philippines, this will usually be late night to early morning, depending on daylight saving time.



Compensation

Part-time: Monthly 32,00–35,000 PHP, depending on experience

20 hours per week

Compensation will depend on outbound calling experience, English communication quality, accent clarity, reliability, attention to detail, and performance.



Please answer the form:





Important

We are looking for someone professional, reliable, detail-oriented, and comfortable making outbound calls to North American businesses.

This is not a high-pressure sales job. We value clear communication, accurate data, polite follow-up, and consistent daily execution.

title: Executive Assistant (Marketing & Content Focus)
description:
Executive Assistant (Marketing & Content Focus)

Dr. Elsa Zekeng · London (Hybrid) · Full-time or Part-time considered

---

About the role



I am a scientist, founder, and public communicator working at the intersection of health, AI, and equity. My work spans building a company, advising organisations, speaking at global events, and increasingly translating complex science into content that people can actually use.



I am looking for an Executive Assistant who gets both sides of that. Someone who can keep my professional life organised and moving, and who can help me show up consistently and compellingly online; turning talks, ideas, and 
nts into content that reaches the people it is meant for.



If you are organised, creative, and genuinely interested in science and health, this is a rare role with real variety and real impact.



---



What you will do



Executive support:

- Manage my calendar, inbox, and scheduling across a busy portfolio of commitments, speaking engagements, investor meetings, media, advisory work

- Handle logistics for events, travel, and appearances

- Draft correspondence, briefing notes, and follow-up communications

- Keep track of deadlines and priorities across multiple simultaneous workstreams



Content & social media

- Own my content calendar: planning, scheduling, and publishing across LinkedIn and other platforms

- Turn existing material: talks, interviews, research, ideas I share with you, into posts, captions, and short-form content

- Maintain a consistent voice and posting rhythm even when I am heads-down elsewhere

- Monitor what is landing and flag patterns worth paying attention to

- Keep a clear picture of where interest is coming from, who is engaging, and what is converting into real opportunities



Short-form content creation (desirable)

- Edit short-form video for LinkedIn, Substack, Tiktok, or similar: event clips, talking heads, science explainers

- Basic image editing, graphic creation, and caption work

- Clip and package longer recordings for social distribution



---



What I am looking for



Essential

- Experience supporting a founder, executive, or public-facing individual: you understand what it means to work in someone else's orbit and make them better

- Strong written English and the ability to write in someone else's voice accurately

- Hands-on experience managing social content, particularly LinkedIn

- Proactive, organised, and able to use good judgement without being directed on every decision

- Genuine interest in science, health, or technology; you do not need a PhD, but you need to care about the subject matter



Desirable

- Video editing skills: short-form, vertical format, captions, basic audio and colour correction

- Photo editing and graphic creation (Canva, Figma, or equivalent)

- Experience supporting someone with a public profile or personal brand



---



What this role offers

- Variety; no two weeks look the same

- Real responsibility and creative input from day one

- Flexibility on working pattern for the right person

- A close working relationship with someone who takes communication seriously and will invest in you



---



I am committed to building a team that reflects the diversity I advocate for in my work. 

Applications from candidates of all backgrounds are genuinely welcome.

title: Construction Project Coordinator/Project Manager
description:
I'll cut straight to it, we are looking to hire two new tea
mbers for long-term, 10 years plus. We are looking for like-minded tea
mbers, the right person for the right seat, while we are in the process of getting to greatness. You have to be self-driven with very high goals and willing to give it 110%, like the rest of our team. For the right person, this will be easy and work with our team; for the wrong person, you will hate it.



Do us both a favor and don't waste our time if you dont have the above, or share our core values and culture of standards.



Department: Project Management

Reports To: Project Manager (Senior PM / GM CC’d as required)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time, Non-Exempt



Who is Team RRE?

We are team players who prioritize open communication while exercising emotional control. We do the right thing and are dedicated to winning. We are not perfect—we learn from our mistakes in the process of being great.



Team RRE Core Values

We Are Team Players

We Prioritize Open Communication

We Exercise Emotional Control

We Do the Right Thing

We Are Dedicated to Winning



Vision

To be the greatest nationwide, relationship-based electrical contractor with the best culture for our tea
mbers.



Purpose

To serve our clients with the highest level of communication and provide maximum value in order to build long-term, relationship-based partnerships.



What’s In It for You

Strong, winning Team culture

Permanent, full-time position

Growth opportunities as we expand locally and nationwide

Access to company health plan (Kaiser Permanente)

Dental and vision coverage

Retirement plan

Six paid holidays per year



Position Overview

The PC/PM is a critical support role responsible for relieving Project Managers of coordination, documentation, tracking, and field-support responsibilities so projects are executed efficiently, profitably, and professionally.



This role serves as a central communication hub between Project Managers, field tea
mbers, vendors, clients, and general contractors. Extreme organization, proactive communication, emotional control, and a strong desire to help Team RRE win are required.



Why PC/PM?

We want you to grow here and develop your project management skills. Start thinking and working like a Project Manager by understanding not only where the project stands today, but also where it will be by the end of the month. By reviewing billings, labor hours, material purchases, schedules, and project completion percentages, you'll gain a better understanding of project forecasting, cost control, and overall project performance.



The goal is to help you become proactive, make informed decisions, and take ownership of your projects—not just manage today's tasks, but plan ahead for successful project completion.



Key Responsibilities & Tasks

Project Setup

Prepare job folders upon contract award and ensure all documents are properly organized in Google Drive.

Coordinate and distribute startup documentation, including:

Certificates of Insurance (including additional insured)

Business licenses

Joint Check Agreements

Team Introduction Letters

Communicate with material vendors (e.g., Platt) to establish job accounts.

Assist Project Managers with job costing worksheets and ensure Accounting loads projects into QuickBooks.

Prepare Statements of Values and load them into Google Sheets and Contractor Foreman.

Address and track all required submittals.



Tracking & Documentation

Track schedules and coordinate all active work.

Track daily site reports and store them in the appropriate folders.

Track site photos and organize albums by job phase and date.

Receive incoming job-related
s and route critical requests to the Project Manager per direction.

Update each job’s status line weekly.

Generate a Weekly Job Team Talk (WJTT) Google Doc for every active job, serving as the official weekly update.



Weekly Job Team Talks (WJTT)

Prepare, distribute, and track WJTTs for every job, every week.

Ensure WJTTs clearly communicate:

Job progress

Schedule status

Labor hours and production

Material status and deliveries

Risks, constraints, and next steps

Coordinate WJTTs with jobsite Leads and GC on-site supervisors as required.

Store all WJTT documentation in Google Drive per Team RRE standards.



Contractor Foreman Tasks

Load jobs into Contractor Foreman, including plans, documents, and communications.

Ensure Daily Logs are completed and tracked.

Load new field tea
mbers, assign roles, and verify system access.

Support onboarding by ensuring field tea
mbers can access the app and locate assigned jobs.

Keep Contractor Foreman clean and current as jobs close out.

Ensure end-of-month job inspections and percentage-of-completion updates are completed and posted.





Field Support, Materials & Equipment

Monitor equipment rentals and usage to minimize unnecessary costs.

Assist Purchasing with large material orders, equipment vendors, pricing, approvals, and follow-ups.

title: UI/UX Designer (B2B SaaS)
description:
UI/UX Designer (B2B SaaS)

Company: WorkWise Auto Solutions

Remote: Philippines



About WorkWise Auto Solutions

WorkWise Auto Solutions is transforming how automotive workshops operate. We help shop owners streamline their workflow, reduce administrative stress, and increase profitability through a combination of smart systems and human support.

Our core service revolves around Virtual Service Advisors (VSAs) who handle customer communication, booking triage, job approvals, and workflow optimisation. We also build internal tools, marketing assets, and client-facing platforms to support that mission, and that’s where you come in.





If you have ever sat in a project watching developers make the design decisions, knowing you could have made the product genuinely better if someone had just handed you the keys, this role was written for you.

We are upgrading our Elite Platform, a software platform used by Australian auto workshops, and we are looking for one designer to own how it looks and how it works, from the first wireframe to the final build-ready file.

Right now, our developers are designing as they build. It works, but it means constant revisions and a look that drifts from screen to screen. We want someone to step in and bring it all together into one clear, consistent, genuinely usable product. The users are real mechanics and service advisors with grease on their hands and no patience for clutter, so the work is about clarity and flow, not decoration.

This starts as a 3-month full-time project to design and ship Elite V2. When you prove this is your thing, it becomes a permanent role, with you owning the look and feel of everything we build from then on.



This is you

- You have designed real B2B SaaS or web apps, and Figma feels like home.

- You look at a cluttered, complicated screen and you actually enjoy finding the simple version hiding inside it.

- You design for the person using the product, not to impress other designers, and you can explain the thinking behind a choice instead of just saying it looks better.

- You have opinions, and you hold them lightly. Feedback makes your work sharper, not defensive.

- You think in systems. Sitemaps, navigation, and a clean component library are how your mind already works.

- You are done with short gigs. You want somewhere to settle in, take ownership, and watch something get better because of you.

If you read that and felt a quiet yes, keep going. 



What you will do day to day

- Turn our team’s ideas into complete, ready-to-build designs.

- Create wireframes and high-fidelity clickable prototypes in Figma.

- Build and maintain a design system so every screen feels like part of the same product.

- Design clear layouts for data-heavy screens like tables, dashboards, scheduling calendars, inventory, and financial reports.

- Make designs work beautifully across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

- Hand developers clean files, assets, and documentation they can build from accurately.

- Run simple usability checks so problems get caught before a line of code is written.



One real 
nt from the role

The messy workflow

A workshop needs to invoice one repair job that involved three different parts, two mechanics, and a follow-up booking. The developers hand you a cluttered screen with everything crammed in. How do you redesign it so a busy service advisor reads it in seconds and misses nothing?

If your mind has already started solving that, picturing the layout, d
 what to cut, you are the person we are looking for. That instinct matters to us far more than a polished resume.



Why you will like it here

- You own the whole product, not a corner of it. The design is yours to shape.

- 100% remote. Work from anywhere in the Philippines.

- Australian day-shift hours, so your evenings and your family time stay yours.

- Competitive pay in AUD, paid straight to your bank account.

- Real growth. Strong performers move from project work into a permanent, long-term role.

- A team that respects clear thinking and good design, and actually listens to its designer.



What you will need

- Solid experience designing B2B SaaS or web apps. A portfolio link is required.

- Expert-level Figma, with wireframing, prototyping, design systems, and developer handoff.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- A reliable computer that runs Figma smoothly, a stable internet (tell us your real speed), and a quiet space for calls.



How to apply

Applications are only reviewed through the form below, not by
 or through this post.

Apply here: 
 

Select “UI/UX Designer” as the position.



Two things we read first, so please do not skip them:

1. Share your portfolio link, and point us to one B2B SaaS or web app screen you are proud of.

2. Tell us about one complex interface you simplified. What was messy, and how did you solve it? Describe it for us. Do not just list it.

Position Overview

Payroll Administration

Review payroll data for accuracy, including wages, overtime, bonuses, commissions, reimbursements, and deductions.

Maintain employee payroll records and compensation information.

Assist with payroll audits and payroll-related compliance documentation.

Research payroll discrepancies and support timely resolution.

Accounting & Reconciliation

Perform payroll reconciliations and assist with month-end closing activities.

Reconcile payroll-related accounts and investigate variances.

Support preparation of journal entries and payroll-related accounting documentation.

Maintain organized financial records and supporting documentation.

Assist with internal reporting and management requests.

Benefits & Employee Data Administration

Support administration of employee benefits, including health, dental, vision, HSA, and retirement plans.

Assist with employee onboarding, offboarding, and payroll system updates.

Process compensation changes, deductions, and benefit-related updates.

Maintain accurate employee records across payroll and accounting systems.

Reporting & Compliance

Prepare payroll summaries and financial support reports for leadership review.

Assist with audit preparation and documentation requests.

Ensure confidentiality and security of employee and financial information.

Follow established procedures and contribute to process improvements.

Qualifications

Required

Bachelor's Degree in Accounting/Bookkeeping

Minimum of 3 years of payroll, accounting, bookkeeping, or related financial experience.

Strong understanding of accounting principles, including reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, and financial reporting.

Experience working with payroll systems such as Gusto, ADP, QuickBooks Payroll, Paychex, or similar platforms.

Advanced proficiency with Quickbooks and Excel. Certifications would be prefered. 

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision.

High level of integrity, professionalism, and discretion.

Preferred

CPA designation or CPA candidate.

Experience supporting U.S.-based payroll operations.

Experience with benefits administration and employee compensation tracking.

Experience supporting accounting close processes and financial reporting.

What We're Looking For



We are seeking someone who:



Understands payroll from an accounting and reconciliation perspective, not just data entry.

Takes ownership of recurring financial processes.

Identifies problems proactively and works toward root-cause solutions.

Demonstrates exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

Communicates clearly and professionally with U.S.-based leadership.

Thrives in a structured, fast-paced environment.

Consistently follows established procedures while seeking opportunities for improvement.

Compensation



Compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, and demonstrated payroll/accounting expertise.



Independent Contractor Notice



This is an independent contractor engagement and does not create an employer-employee relationship. The contractor is responsible for managing their own taxes, benefits, equipment, and work environment in accordance with applicable laws.



Responsibilities may evolve as the company grows, with opportunities to expand into broader accounting, financial reporting, and operational support functions.

This role serves as a key behind-the-scenes support function, ensuring that business operations, product information, marketing materials, and digital platforms remain accurate, current, and professionally maintained.



The successful candidate will work closely with the Managing Director and internal travel team. The ideal person will be technically capable, detail-oriented, self-motivated, and comfortable managing a diverse range of digital, marketing, and administrative responsibilities.



This multifaceted role combines WordPress website management, Flatsome/UX Builder content updates, SharePoint administration, supplier and product updates, marketing collateral creation, social media support, digital organization, and general business administration.







Key Responsibilities



1. Executive Support



Provide day-to-day administrative and operational support to the Managing Director.

Assist with business projects, marketing initiatives, supplier communications, and internal administration.

Prepare, format, and update documents, spreadsheets, reports, and business resources.

Maintain action lists, monitor outstanding tasks, and help ensure projects progress to completion.

Assist with
 drafting, document formatting, file management, and general coordination.





2. Website & WordPress Management



Update and maintain company websites using WordPress.

Manage website content using Flatsome and UX Builder.

Create, edit, and maintain resort pages, holiday package pages, wedding pages, landing pages, and general website content.

Upload and format images, PDFs, flyers, and promotional materials.

Perform basic website modifications using HTML and CSS.

Review website functionality, including links, formatting, page layouts, and mobile responsiveness.

Implement basic SEO updates, including:

Page titles

Meta descriptions

Image alt text

Internal linking

Identify outdated content, broken links, formatting issues, and missing information, escalating concerns to the Managing Director.

Ensure all website content remains accurate, current, and aligned with brand standards.





3. SharePoint Intranet & Product Information Management



Update and maintain product information within Microsoft SharePoint.

Upload, organize, and manage supplier updates, resort information, rate sheets, product flyers, and training materials.

Ensure internal product information remains current and accessible for the travel consultant team.

Create and update product summaries, supplier notes, and reference documentation.

Maintain consistency between website content, SharePoint resources, and marketing collateral.

Ensure product information is clearly organized and easily accessible.

Support version control and digital file management across SharePoint and OneDrive.





4. Supplier & Product Administration



Review supplier and resort updates and convert them into clear website, intranet, and marketing collateral updates.

Maintain accurate product information across both internal and external platforms.

Update offers, resort inclusions, package details, supplier notes, and product documentation.

Support the Managing Director with supplier-related administration and communications.

Help ensure the travel team has access to accurate and up-to-date product information.





5. Marketing Collateral Development



Create, update, and maintain marketing materials, including:



Wedding flyers

Resort flyers

Holiday package flyers

Agent flyers

Client-facing documents

Product update sheets

Promotional PDFs

Internal reference materials

Additional responsibilities include:



Updating existing templates and creating new collateral as required.

Preparing materials for digital distribution,
 campaigns, website uploads, and print production.

Ensuring all collateral is accurate, visually professional, and aligned with company branding.

Assisting with image resizing, PDF preparation, and document presentation.





6. Social Media Support



Assist with creating, scheduling, and publishing content across social media platforms.

Develop basic graphics, captions, and promotional posts.

Support campaigns focused on holidays, resorts, weddings, honeymoons, and special offers.

Maintain a consistent brand presence across:


Instagram

LinkedIn

Other relevant platforms

Monitor basic engagement and escalate enquiries to the appropriate tea
mbers.

Repurpose website and supplier content for social media use.





7. Administration & Digital Organization



Maintain organized digital files across Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and OneDrive.

Assist with supplier information management, product records, marketing databases, and business documentation.

Support ad hoc business, marketing, and administrative projects.

Improve internal templates, filing systems, and administrative processes where appropriate.

Ensure documents are properly named, filed, and easy to retrieve.

Perform general administrative duties as requested by the Managing Director.





Essential Skills & Experience



Candidates must possess:



Strong WordPress experience.

Experience with Flatsome / UX Builder, or extensive experience with WordPress page builders and the ability to learn quickly.

Basic HTML and CSS skills.

Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.

Proficiency in:

Outlook

Word

Teams

SharePoint

OneDrive

Experience managing website content, digital assets, and marketing materials.

Strong document formatting and presentation skills.

Excellent attention to detail.

Ability to follow instructions accurately.

Ability to work independently and effectively manage priorities.

Strong organizational and time-management skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously.

Confidence working across multiple brands, platforms, and business functions.





Highly Desirable Skills



Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, including:

InDesign

Photoshop

Illustrator

Acrobat

Canva experience.

Experience creating:

Flyers

Brochures

Promotional PDFs

Client-facing documents

Experience maintaining a SharePoint intranet.

Experience within the travel, tourism, wedding, or hospitality industries.

Key Systems & Platforms

Microsoft 365

Personal Attributes

Proactive and solution-focused

Reliable and responsive

Technically capable and confident with digital platforms

Creative yet practical

Able to follow instructions carefully

Comfortable asking questions when clarification is required

Effective at managing multiple priorities

Capable of working independently once trained

Professional, discreet, and trustworthy

Comfortable taking ownership of recurring responsibilities

Able to identify issues and recommend practical improvements

Adaptable within a small business environment where priorities may change





Role Priorities



The primary priorities of this role are:



Providing reliable executive support to the Managing Director.

Maintaining accurate, current, and professionally presented websites.

Keeping SharePoint and internal product information up to date.

Producing and maintaining professional marketing collateral.

Supporting social media and broader marketing activities.

Maintaining organized business documentation and digital resources.

Ensuring projects and tasks are progressed through to completion.



15 hours/week



The candidates who will follow the instructions are the only one to be considered:

1. On the subject of your application please add the word "Amadeus"

2. Answer the following questions on your message. I don't need other details:

• Do you have experience creating flyers, brochures, PDFs, or marketing materials? Which tools have you used (Canva, Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, Acrobat)?

• Which social media platforms have you managed, and what type of content have you created or scheduled?

• Are you currently employed? If yes, what is your current role and why are you looking for a new opportunity?

• Please also confirm:

    - Do you have reliable high-speed internet?

title: Creative Strategist - DTC Ecommerce Brand (Fast growing)
description:
Creative Strategist — Remote

Requirement: track record of producing ads that scale for 8-9 figure brands



We're not looking for someone to "assist" or "support" a creative team.

We're looking for someone to lead one.



This is your chance to join a fast growing DTC brand with a simple goal: become the category leader. We've got strong product, strong offer, and strong data. What we're building now is a world-class creative operation — and this role is the centerpiece of that.



What This Role Actually Is:



You'll own your own pod. Two editors, a roster of UGC creators, and full creative authority over the concepts, hooks, and angles that go to market under your direction.



You won't be executing someone else's system. You'll be bringing your own.



Who We're Looking For:

You have a genuine track record. Not "I worked at an agency that worked with big brands." You personally conceived and developed ad concepts that scaled for 8 or 9 figure brands. 



You think in avatars, not audiences. You understand that the creative IS the targeting, and you know how to write to a specific person in a way that makes them feel like the ad was made for them.



You have strong opinions about what makes ads work and lose. You're not waiting on data to tell you something is bad — you already know, and you can articulate why.



You're done being one of five strategists. You want ownership.



What You'll Do:



- Develop and own the full creative strategy for your pod — concepts, hooks, formats, angles



- Brief and direct UGC creators to produce content that performs, not just content that looks good



- Manage two editors with clear direction and high standards



- Build and iterate your testing framework, not ours

Report on performance and make the calls on what scales and what gets cut





What We're NOT Looking For:



Someone who needs a detailed brief to get started

Someone whose best work was done by the team around them

Someone who equates "polished" with "good"

Someone looking for a lateral move with a new logo on their resume





Compensation

This role is paid at a top of the market salary + fantastic performance bonus. If you're the right person, we'll make it work.

title: Financial Operations Manager
description:
Accounting • Payroll • Collections • Cash Flow • Construction Billing



US* Remote



**Employment Type:** Full-Time



**Compensation:** Based on Experience



## About Us



We are a growing U.S.-based property management, construction, and real estate organization seeking a highly organized Financial Operations Manager to oversee financial administration, collections, payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, reporting, and operational accounting functions.



This role is critical to the financial health of the company and requires someone who can work independently, communicate effectively, and proactively identify issues before they become problems.



This is not a basic bookkeeping position. We are looking for someone who can take ownership of financial operations and provide leadership with accurate, timely information.



---



## Responsibilities



### Accounting & Financial Administration



* Maintain accurate accounting records

* Manage QuickBooks Online

* Perform account reconciliations

* Review transaction coding

* Maintain vendor records

* Support month-end close activities

* Prepare financial reporting packages



### Accounts Receivable & Collections



* Monitor aging reports

* Follow up on overdue balances

* Manage collection activities

* Document collection efforts

* Escalate collection risks

* Maintain collection reporting



### Accounts Payable



* Review and process vendor invoices

* Verify supporting documentation

* Schedule vendor payments

* Maintain AP aging reports

* Resolve vendor discrepancies



### Payroll Administration



* Review employee timesheets

* Process payroll accurately and on time

* Verify commission calculations

* Audit overtime and payroll exceptions

* Maintain payroll records



### Cash Flow Reporting



* Prepare weekly cash flow reports

* Forecast upcoming obligations

* Monitor bank balances

* Identify collection concerns

* Report financial risks to leadership



### Construction & Project Billing



* Track project billing

* Support progress invoicing

* Manage change order billing

* Track project costs

* Verify completion documentation

* Maintain project financial records



---



## Qualifications



Required:



* QuickBooks Online experience

* Accounts Receivable experience

* Accounts Payable experience

* Payroll processing experience

* Strong Excel skills

* Excellent written English

* Strong organizational skills



Preferred:



* Property management accounting experience

* Construction accounting experience

* Job costing experience

* Financial reporting experience



---



## Success Factors



The ideal candidate:



* Is highly organized

* Pays close attention to detail

* Can manage multiple priorities

* Communicates proactively

* Takes ownership of results

* Follows processes consistently

* Is comfortable working independently



---



## Application Instructions



To help us identify candidates who pay attention to detail, please include the phrase **"Cash Flow First"** in the first line of your application message.



Please also provide:



1. Resume

2. Desired monthly compensation

3. Years of QuickBooks experience

4. Years of payroll experience

5. Experience with property management accounting

6. Experience with construction accounting

7. Availability to start

8. A brief explanation of how you would collect a 60-day overdue invoice



Applications that do not follow all instructions may not be considered.



---



## Additional Screening Question



Please answer the following:



A customer owes $15,000, payroll is due Friday, vendor bills total $6,000, and only $12,000 is available in the bank.



What actions would you take first, and why?



We are looking for candidates who think critically, communicate clearly, and take ownership of financial outcomes.
